name: Archer Push-up
description: Wide hand placement, shift weight to one arm as you lower, keeping other arm extended. Alternate sides.

name: Assisted One-Arm Pull-up
description: One hand on bar, other hand grips same wrist for assistance. Lower the assistance over time.

name: Band Tricep Pushdown
description: Anchor band overhead, grip with both hands, extend elbows driving hands toward thighs. Full lockout.

name: Band-Assisted Muscle-up
description: With resistance band for assistance, pull explosively from hang to push-up position above bar.

name: Bar Hang (Active)
description: Dead hang from bar with active shoulder depression and retraction. No passive shrugging.

name: Chin-up
description: Supinated grip, pull chin above bar from dead hang. Lower with control.

name: Clap Push-up
description: Explosive push-up, clap hands at top before landing. Builds upper body power.

name: Close-Grip Push-up
description: Hands shoulder-width or narrower, lower chest between hands. Emphasizes triceps and inner chest.

name: Commando Pull-up
description: Hands staggered on bar, pull chin to one side then alternate. Works biceps and lats unevenly.

name: Diamond Push-up
description: Hands close together forming a diamond, lower chest to hands. Press up.

name: Elbow Plank to Push-up
description: Alternate between forearm plank and push-up top position one arm at a time. Control the transition.

name: Fingertip Push-up
description: Push-up on fingertips only. Builds grip strength and finger tendon resilience for bar work.

name: Forearm Curl
description: Kneel, forearms on bench, wrists hanging off edge, curl weight through full wrist range of motion.

name: Gymnastic Ring Push-up Hold
description: Hold top position of ring push-up with rings turned out 45 degrees. Builds ring stability.

name: Hang to Row
description: From dead hang, perform inverted row pulling chest to bar. Smooth transition between movements.

name: Hollow Push-up
description: Maintain hollow body position throughout push-up movement. No hip sag, back flat.

name: L-Pull-up
description: Maintain L-sit position (legs parallel to floor) throughout entire pull-up movement. Extreme core demand.

name: Negative Pull-up
description: Jump to top position, lower yourself as slowly as possible (5-10 seconds). Build pull strength eccentrically.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-up
description: Parallel grip (palms facing each other), pull chin to bar level. Easier on shoulders than pronated grip.

name: One-Arm Push-up Progression
description: Full wide-leg one-arm push-up, lower chest to floor with control. Keep hips square.

name: Pike Handstand Push-up Negative
description: From handstand against wall, lower head slowly toward floor over 5 seconds. Press back up.

name: Pike Push-up
description: In inverted V position, bend elbows and lower crown toward floor. Press back up.

name: Planche Lean
description: In push-up position, lean forward shifting shoulders past hands. Hold body rigid. Build planche strength.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-up
description: Hands near hips, lean forward and perform push-up keeping body rigid.

name: Reverse Grip Push-up
description: Hands turned outward 180 degrees (fingers pointing toward feet). Unusual bicep and forearm load.

name: Ring Bicep Curl
description: Stand facing anchor point, lean back with rings at hip level, curl rings to forehead. Adjust angle.

name: Ring Dip
description: On gymnastic rings, lower body until upper arms parallel to floor. Press back to lockout, turn rings out.

name: Ring Push-up
description: Push-up with hands on gymnastic rings, keep rings stable throughout movement.

name: Rope Climb (arms only)
description: Climb rope using only arm strength, no leg wrapping allowed.

name: Scapular Push-up
description: In push-up top position, protract and retract scapulae without bending elbows. Serratus anterior work.

name: Straddle Planche Lean
description: Legs straddled wide, lean forward on hands shifting center of mass over wrists. Advanced planche prep.

name: Superman Push-up
description: Explosive push-up launching hands and feet off ground simultaneously. Land softly.

name: Towel Pull-up
description: Drape towels over bar, grip one in each hand, perform pull-up. Challenges grip and forearm strength.

name: Tricep Dips
description: On parallel bars or chair, lower body by bending elbows. Press back to straight.

name: Tricep Push-up
description: Hands directly under shoulders, elbows track straight back as you lower. Press back up keeping elbows tight to body.

name: Tuck Front Lever Row
description: In tuck front lever position on bar, perform rowing motion pulling chest to bar.

name: Typewriter Pull-up
description: Pull up, then slide body to one side keeping chin above bar, across and down the other side.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-up
description: Hands wider than shoulder-width, pull chest toward bar. Emphasizes lat width over bicep.

name: Wrist Push-up
description: Push-up on back of wrists (fists facing down). Builds wrist flexor strength and conditioning.

name: Wrist Roller
description: Hold roller at shoulder height, wind and unwind weight using only wrists.

name: Arch Body Rock
description: In arch body position (prone, arms and legs raised), rock forward and back maintaining shape.

name: Arch Pulls
description: Hang from bar in arched position, pull with scapula retraction and depression.

name: Arch to Hollow on Bar
description: Hang from bar, alternate between arch position and hollow position in a controlled swing cycle.

name: Back Extension
description: On GHD or prone on floor, hinge at hips to lower and raise torso.

name: Band Pull-Down
description: Anchor band overhead, face anchor, pull band to chest keeping arms slightly bent. Full lat contraction.

name: Banded Good Morning
description: Band anchored under feet and over shoulders, hinge at hips maintaining flat back, stand tall.

name: Bear Hug Carry
description: Hug a heavy bag or medicine ball to chest, walk for distance maintaining upright posture.

name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-up
description: Full pull-up driving chest to touch the bar. Requires greater range and lat strength.

name: Close-Grip Pull-up
description: Hands close together on bar, pull chin over. More bicep involvement than wide grip.

name: Dead Hang Shrug
description: From dead hang, depress shoulders pulling body up without bending elbows. Pure scapular control.

name: Face Pull
description: Anchor band at face height, pull toward face with elbows flared high. External rotation and rear delt.

name: Front Lever Progression
description: Straddle front lever hold — legs open wide, body horizontal on bar with arms straight.

name: Front Lever Tuck Hold
description: On bar, pull into tucked horizontal hold with arms straight, body parallel to floor.

name: GHD Raise
description: On glute-ham developer, lower torso below parallel and raise back up. Full range hip extension.

name: Good Morning
description: Feet hip-width, hinge at hips with flat back until torso parallel to floor. Drive hips forward to stand.

name: Hollow Body Pull-up
description: Maintain strict hollow body (no arch) throughout pull-up. Gymnastics-specific pulling pattern.

name: Horizontal Pull-up
description: Feet elevated to make body horizontal, pull chest to bar from fully horizontal position. Max lat load.

name: Inverted Hang
description: Hang inverted from bar (toes to bar then extend inverted), hold still. Builds inverted body awareness.

name: Inverted Row
description: Hang below bar with straight body, pull chest to bar. Lower with control.

name: Kipping Pull-up
description: Use hip drive to generate momentum, then pull explosively. Gymnastics conditioning tool for volume.

name: Mixed Grip Pull-up
description: One hand pronated, one supinated on bar. Pull-up targets bicep and lat differently each set.

name: Muscle-up Negative
description: Start at top of muscle-up (in dip position above bar), lower slowly through transition to hang.

name: Negative Front Lever
description: From inverted hang, lower body slowly to horizontal position. Resist throughout the descent.

name: Prone Cobra
description: Lie face down, place hands by hips, press up through hands lifting chest. Hold at top.

name: Prone T Raise
description: Lie face down, raise arms to T position (directly to sides) squeezing rear delts. Lower slowly.

name: Pull-up
description: Pronated grip, pull chin above bar from dead hang. Controlled lower.

name: Renegade Row
description: In push-up position with weights, row one arm at a time. Keep hips square throughout.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Lie on elevated surface, hang legs off edge, raise legs to horizontal using glutes and lower back.

name: Reverse Snow Angel
description: Lie face down arms at sides, trace arms from hips to overhead and back, keeping arms off floor.

name: Ring Pull-up
description: Pull-up using gymnastic rings. Rings allowed to rotate naturally. More shoulder-friendly than bar.

name: Ring Row
description: Heels on floor, body straight, pull chest to rings. Adjust angle for difficulty.

name: Scapular Pull-up
description: From dead hang, retract scapulae to raise body slightly. No elbow bend.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Sit facing anchor point, feet braced, row handles to lower ribs. Squeeze scapulae at finish.

name: Single-Arm Row
description: One hand and knee on bench, row dumbbell or band to hip with other arm. Squeeze at top.

name: Skin the Cat
description: Hang from bar or rings, pike legs through to German hang. Return with control.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: Hinge at hips with minimal knee bend, lower weights to mid-shin, drive hips to stand. Hamstring and back.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
description: Stand facing anchor, arms straight, pull hands from overhead to hips. Lats only, no elbow bend.

name: Superman Hold
description: Lie prone, extend arms and legs and lift all four limbs off floor. Hold.

name: Thoracic Extension
description: Sit upright, hands behind head, extend upper back over a foam roller or the edge of a bench.

name: Y-T-W Raise
description: Prone on floor, raise arms into Y, then T, then W position. Hits all three lower trap fibers.

name: Ankle Hops
description: Small rapid hops using only ankle plantarflexion, knees mostly straight. Builds ankle stiffness.

name: Box Jump
description: Jump onto box or raised surface, land in squat position. Step or jump down.

name: Broad Jump
description: From standing, swing arms and jump as far forward as possible. Land balanced.

name: Broad Jump Series
description: Three consecutive broad jumps for maximum distance. Emphasizes horizontal power and landing.

name: Cossack Squat
description: Wide stance, shift weight fully to one side into deep squat while extending opposite leg out flat.

name: Depth Jump
description: Step off box, land and immediately jump as high as possible. Minimal ground contact time.

name: Drop Squat
description: From standing drop explosively into deep squat position landing softly. Builds reactive strength.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on back knees bent, drive hips to ceiling squeezing glutes at top. Lower with control.

name: Hip Flexor March
description: Standing, drive knees up to hip height alternately with control. Targets hip flexors and balance.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Shoulders on bench, hips hinged toward floor, drive hips to full extension squeezing glutes hard.

name: Ice Skater
description: Lateral bounds with exaggerated lean, trailing leg sweeps behind. Continuous side-to-side.

name: Jump Squat
description: Squat to parallel, explode upward, land softly through full foot. Reset.

name: Jumping Lunge
description: Lunge, explode upward switching legs in air, land in opposite lunge. Alternate continuously.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: Band around ankles, take small steps sideways maintaining quarter-squat position throughout.

name: Lateral Bound
description: Jump sideways off one foot, land on opposite foot. Control landing, pause, repeat other direction.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: Step wide to one side, push hips back and bend that knee. Drive through heel back to standing.

name: Lunge Pulse
description: Hold bottom of lunge, pulse up and down 2-3 inches. Isometric endurance in lunge position.

name: Nordic Curl
description: Kneel with feet anchored, lower body toward floor with control. Use arms to return.

name: Pistol Squat
description: Single leg squat to full depth with opposite leg extended forward. Stand back up.

name: Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated on bench, front foot far forward. Deep lunge with upright torso.

name: Relevé Hold
description: Rise to toes on both feet, maintain balance and alignment. Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step back onto toes, lower back knee toward floor. Drive through front foot to return. Controlled.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Stand tall, hinge at hips with soft knees lowering weights along legs until hamstring tension. Drive up.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Seated, weight on knees, raise heels through full range of motion. Targets soleus specifically.

name: Single Leg Calf Raise
description: Stand on one foot on edge of step, raise and lower heel through full range.

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
description: Jump onto box from one leg, land on same leg with control. Maximum single-leg power output.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: Same as glute bridge with one leg extended. Full glute contraction on working side.

name: Skater Squat
description: Single-leg squat lowering back knee toward floor. Non-working leg trails behind, no support.

name: Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated, lower back knee toward floor. Drive through front heel.

name: Squat Hold
description: Deep squat with feet flat, hold at bottom. Builds hip and ankle mobility alongside leg strength.

name: Squat Jump to Tuck
description: Squat, jump and tuck knees to chest, land softly. Explosive power with body awareness.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Both feet on edge of step, lower heels below step level and raise to full tip-toe. Full range.

name: Standing Hip Circle
description: Stand on one leg, trace large circles with opposite knee. Hip mobility and single-leg stability.

name: Step-Up
description: Step onto a box or bench with one foot, drive through heel to stand on top. Step down controlled.

name: Sumo Squat
description: Wide stance with toes pointed out, squat deep while keeping chest tall and knees tracking toes.

name: Tempo Squat
description: Three-second descent, one-second pause at bottom, one-second rise. Builds eccentric strength.

name: Terminal Knee Extension
description: Band behind knee, slight knee bend, fully extend knee against band resistance. VMO focused.

name: Tuck Jump
description: Jump and pull knees to chest at peak height. Land softly.

name: Wall Sit
description: Back flat on wall, thighs parallel to floor. Hold position.

name: Wall-Supported Pistol
description: Use wall for light balance assist only while performing pistol squat. Wean off support over time.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: From knees, roll wheel forward maintaining rigid torso, roll back. Never let hips drop.

name: Arch Body Hold
description: Lie face down, lift arms and legs off the floor simultaneously. Hold and squeeze.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Alternate elbow to opposite knee in a pedaling motion. Full rotation each rep, no rushing.

name: Bird Dog
description: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously. Hold 2 seconds. Keep hips level.

name: Boat Pose Hold
description: Seated, legs straight at 45 degrees, arms parallel to floor. Full V-sit hold for time.

name: Copenhagen Plank
description: Side plank with top foot on elevated surface and bottom leg hanging. Adductor and core load.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on back, arms and knees at 90 degrees, lower opposite arm and leg toward floor. Press back.

name: Dragon Flag
description: Lie on bench, grip behind head, raise body as one rigid unit. Lower slowly.

name: Dragon Flag Negative
description: Start horizontal on bench, lower slowly to floor maintaining rigid body. 5-second descent.

name: Flutter Kick
description: Lie on back, arms at sides, legs 6 inches off floor. Alternate small rapid kicks. Back stays flat.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hang from bar, pull knees to chest with control. Lower slowly.

name: Hanging L-Sit
description: From bar hang, maintain legs at 90 degrees (L position). Keep legs straight throughout.

name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
description: Full rotation version — legs go from horizontal on one side, through vertical, to other side.

name: Hip Circles in Hollow
description: Maintain hollow body position while making small circles with both legs together. Extreme core demand.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Lie on your back, press lower back to floor, extend arms overhead and legs low. Hold tight.

name: Hollow Body Rocks
description: In hollow body position, rock forward and back maintaining the shape throughout.

name: Hollow to Arch
description: Lying on floor, alternate between hollow body and arch body position. Full spinal range.

name: Jackknife
description: Lie flat, simultaneously raise straight legs and upper body to meet in the middle. V position.

name: L-Sit Hold
description: On parallettes or floor, press down through hands, lift legs parallel to ground. Hold.

name: Long Lever Plank
description: Forearm plank with arms extended further forward than usual. Increases lever arm difficulty.

name: Pallof Press
description: Band anchored at chest height to side, press arms straight ahead and return. Anti-rotation core.

name: Plank Hold
description: Forearms and toes on floor, body in a straight line. Brace everything.

name: Plank Reach
description: In forearm plank, extend one arm forward and hold 2 seconds. Alternate. Anti-rotation demand.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
description: In push-up top position, tap opposite shoulder. Minimal hip rotation. Core stability under movement.

name: Plank to Downward Dog
description: Alternate between push-up top position and downward dog, pressing through straight arms each time.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: Lie on back, curl hips off floor bringing knees toward chest. Control the lower on the way down.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated with knees bent and feet raised, rotate torso side to side. Add weight for challenge.

name: Scissor Kick
description: Like flutter kick but with larger alternating cross-body leg movements. Keep lower back pressed down.

name: Seated Leg Raise
description: Sit on edge of bench, grip sides, raise straight legs to horizontal and lower. Strict form.

name: Side Plank
description: Forearm on floor, body in straight line sideways. Hold. Stack feet or stagger for stability.

name: Side Plank Hip Dip
description: In side plank, lower and raise hip repeatedly. Adds dynamic demand to lateral chain.

name: Standing Ab Wheel
description: Full standing rollout — roll all the way to floor and back up. Elite core strength required.

name: Stir the Pot
description: Forearms on stability ball in plank, trace small circles with elbows. Extreme anti-rotation demand.

name: Straight-Leg Raise
description: Lie flat, raise straight legs to vertical and lower slowly without touching floor. Back flat.

name: Toes to Bar
description: Hang from bar, keep legs straight and raise toes to touch the bar. Lower with control.

name: Tuck Planche Hold
description: On hands, lean forward and tuck knees to chest off the ground. Hold.

name: Tuck Up
description: From lying flat, simultaneously tuck knees to chest and sit up. Return to lying with control.

name: V-Up
description: From lying flat, simultaneously lift legs and torso to form a V shape. Lower with control.

name: Weighted Sit-up
description: Full sit-up holding weight plate at chest. Controlled on the way down, powerful on the way up.

name: Windshield Wiper
description: Hang from bar, raise legs to horizontal and rotate side to side like a windshield wiper.

name: Alternating Lateral Raise
description: Raise one arm at a time to side, lower with control before raising the other. Slower tempo.

name: Arnold Press
description: Start with palms facing you at shoulder height, press overhead rotating palms forward. Full range.

name: Band Dislocate
description: Wide grip on band, keeping arms straight, pass band over head and behind back and return.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: Hold band at chest width, pull apart to full extension behind body. Return slowly.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Hands and toes on floor, knees 1 inch off ground. Crawl forward maintaining position.

name: Bottoms-Up KB Press
description: Hold kettlebell upside down (bottom up), press overhead. Demands extreme shoulder stability.

name: Cable Face Pull
description: Rope attachment at face height, pull to face with elbows high and wide. Rear delt and external rot.

name: Cuban Press
description: External rotation at 90 degrees followed by overhead press. Full shoulder health movement.

name: External Rotation
description: Elbow at 90 degrees by side or on surface, rotate forearm outward against band resistance.

name: Freestanding Handstand Hold
description: Kick up and balance without wall support. Fingertip corrections, hollow body, active shrug.

name: Front Raise
description: Arms at sides, raise one or both arms to shoulder height in front. Slow and controlled lowering.

name: Half-Kneeling Press
description: Half-kneeling position, press single weight overhead. Eliminates leg drive, isolates shoulder.

name: Handstand Kick-up Practice
description: Kick up to wall handstand repeatedly, focusing on straight body and active shoulder shrug at top.

name: Handstand Pirouette
description: In wall handstand, practice rotating 180 degrees by shifting weight and walking hands around.

name: Handstand Push-up
description: Full freestanding or wall handstand push-up. Lower head to floor, press to full lockout.

name: Handstand Shrug
description: In wall handstand, perform small shoulder shrugs (elevation and depression). Active shoulder work.

name: Handstand Walk
description: Walk on hands in a straight line. Keep body tight, steer with fingertips and shoulder shifts.

name: Handstand Wall Hold
description: Kick up to handstand against wall, maintain straight body and active shrug.

name: Internal Rotation
description: Elbow at 90 degrees, rotate forearm inward against band resistance. For rotator cuff balance.

name: Kipping Swing
description: On bar, alternate between arch and hollow body in rhythmic kipping swing. Gymnastics conditioning.

name: Lateral Raise
description: With light weights or bands, raise arms to sides to shoulder height. Lower slowly.

name: Overhead Hold Walk
description: Hold weight directly overhead with locked elbow, walk for distance maintaining alignment.

name: Overhead Squat Hold
description: Arms locked overhead, squat to depth maintaining vertical torso and active shoulders.

name: Pike Shoulder Tap
description: In pike push-up position, tap opposite shoulder while maintaining balance.

name: Prone W Raise
description: Lie face down, arms in W shape (elbows bent, hands up), raise elbows off floor. Mid trap.

name: Prone Y Raise
description: Lie face down, raise arms to Y position squeezing shoulder blades. Lower slowly.

name: Push Press
description: Small knee dip, then drive weight overhead using leg momentum. More load than strict press.

name: Reverse Fly
description: Hinge at hips, raise arms to sides squeezing rear delts. Counteracts internal rotation dominance.

name: Ring Dip Support
description: Hold top of dip position on rings, rings turned out 45 degrees, maintain for time.

name: Ring Support Hold
description: Support hold above rings with arms locked, rings turned out. Foundation of ring gymnastics.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
description: Back against wall, slide arms up in W-to-Y pattern. Trains scapular upward rotation.

name: Shoulder Press
description: Press weight from shoulders to full lockout overhead. Full extension at top, controlled lowering.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press
description: One hand on end of bar in landmine, press at 45-degree angle overhead. Core and shoulder.

name: Trap-3 Raise
description: Lie at 45-degree angle on bench, raise arm in line with body angle. Lower trap strengthening.

name: Upright Row
description: Grip bar or bands at waist, pull to chin height with elbows flaring wide. Squeeze at top.

name: Wall Handstand Shoulder Touch
description: In wall handstand, shift weight and tap one shoulder. Alternate sides.

name: Wall Walk
description: Start in push-up position feet near wall, walk feet up wall while walking hands toward wall.

name: Wall Walk Hold
description: Walk up to chest-to-wall handstand position and hold. Maximum handstand-specific shoulder load.

name: YTWL Raise
description: Prone, perform Y, T, W, and L raise positions in sequence. Full rotator cuff and trapezius circuit.

name: Z-Press
description: Seated on floor legs straight in front, press weight overhead. Eliminates any leg or back compensation.

name: Active Wrist Pronation/Supination
description: Elbow at 90°, actively rotate forearm through full pronation and supination range. Radioulnar joint activation.

name: Elbow Flexor Stretch
description: Extend arm fully, rotate palm up, gently press wrist toward floor. Bicep and elbow flexor stretch.

name: Finger Tendon Glide
description: Move fingers through: straight, hook fist, full fist, straight knuckle fist. Tendon gliding exercises for finger health.

name: Fist Push-up Wrist Warm-up
description: Push-ups on fists to keep wrist neutral. Wrist conditioning without full extension load.

name: Grip Squeeze (towel)
description: Squeeze a rolled towel as hard as possible for 5 seconds, relax. Grip strengthening and forearm endurance.

name: Hammer Curl (light prehab)
description: Neutral grip curl with very light load. Elbow tendon conditioning. Brachioradialis activation.

name: Pinch Grip Holds
description: Pinch a plate or book between thumb and fingers, hold for time. Pinch strength and thumb tendon conditioning.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Forearms on surface, wrists hanging off edge, extend wrist against gravity. Wrist extensor strengthening.

name: Rice Bucket — Finger Extensions
description: Plunge hand into rice bucket, open fingers against resistance. Finger extensor strengthening for grip balance.

name: Tricep Cross-Body Stretch
description: Raise arm, bend elbow behind head, use other hand to gently press elbow. Tricep and elbow mobility.

name: Wrist CARs
description: Controlled articular rotations of the wrist — trace the largest circle possible in both directions under tension. Essential for gymnastics.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
description: Arm extended, palm down, gently press fingers toward floor. Hold. Forearm extensor and wrist mobility.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
description: Arm extended, palm up, gently press fingers back toward forearm. Hold at point of tension. Forearm flexor mobility.

name: Wrist ISOMETRIC Loading
description: Press palm against wall in flexion, extension, and lateral deviation. Hold each direction. Pain-free wrist loading protocol.

name: Wrist Weight Shifts
description: On all fours, slowly shift weight forward onto fingertips and back. Gradual wrist loading for conditioning.

name: Bird Dog (slow prehab)
description: On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg with 3-second hold at top. Deep multifidus and lumbar stabilizer activation.

name: Cat-Cow
description: On all fours, alternate between arching and rounding the spine with full breath. Spinal mobility and segmental control.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneel, sit back on heels, reach arms overhead on floor. Hold. Thoracic spine and lat stretch with gentle traction.

name: Face Pull (prehab)
description: Rope at face height, pull to face with elbows high. Posterior shoulder chain activation protecting the thoracic spine.

name: Hip Hinge Pattern
description: Hinge at hips with flat back, dowel touching head/back/tailbone. Teaches proper loading mechanics protecting lumbar spine.

name: Lumbar ISOMETRIC Hold
description: Prone on elbows (sphinx position), gently press pubic bone down, feel lower back muscles engage. Lumbar stabilizer activation.

name: McGill Curl-Up
description: One knee bent, hands under lumbar, partial sit-up maintaining neutral spine. Spine-sparing core stability drill.

name: Pallof Press Anti-Rotation
description: Band anchored at chest height, press straight ahead and return. Trains spine to resist rotation under load.

name: Prone Press-Up
description: Lie face down, place hands under shoulders, press upper body up while hips stay down. McKenzie extension for disc health.

name: Quadruped Hip Extension
description: On all fours, extend one leg back to hip height maintaining neutral pelvis. Glute activation protecting lower back.

name: Scapular Retraction Hold
description: Squeeze shoulder blades together and hold for 5 seconds. Mid-trap activation essential for thoracic spine posture.

name: Side-Lying Thoracic Rotation
description: Lie on side knees bent, top arm sweeps overhead to opposite side. Thoracic rotation with rib cage opening.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
description: Lie on back, bring one knee across body while keeping shoulders flat. Lumbar rotation and paraspinal muscle release.

name: Thoracic Extension over Foam Roller
description: Sit with roller behind mid-back, support head, extend over roller one segment at a time. Thoracic mobility.

name: Thread the Needle
description: On all fours, thread one arm under body reaching to opposite side. Thoracic rotation mobility essential for gymnastics.

name: Ankle Alphabet
description: Draw the alphabet with your foot making shapes as large as possible. Full ankle range of motion activation.

name: Ankle CARs
description: Controlled articular rotations of the ankle in full available range under tension. Essential before any jumping or tumbling.

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilisation
description: Half-kneeling at wall, push knee over toes as far as possible. Ankle dorsiflexion mobility crucial for landing mechanics.

name: Calf Raise Eccentric
description: Rise on both feet, lower on one foot over 5 seconds. Soleus and Achilles tendon loading. Injury prevention for jumpers.

name: Clamshell
description: Side-lying, knees bent, rotate top knee up like a clamshell. Glute medius and external hip rotator activation.

name: Couch Stretch
description: Rear foot elevated on wall in lunge, drive hips forward. Hip flexor and quad stretch. Corrects anterior pelvic tilt.

name: Glute Bridge ISOMETRIC Hold
description: Bridge up and hold with maximal glute squeeze. Gluteal activation and hip extension pattern reinforcement.

name: Hip 90/90 Stretch
description: Sit with both hips at 90°, rotate between positions. Hip internal and external rotation mobility for healthy knee alignment.

name: Hip FABER Stretch
description: Lie on back, cross ankle over opposite knee, gently press knee down or pull shin toward chest. Piriformis and hip external rotator.

name: Lateral Band Walk (prehab)
description: Mini-band at ankles, quarter-squat, step side to side. Gluteus medius activation for knee valgus prevention.

name: Nordic Curl Negative (assisted)
description: Use a band for assistance, lower body toward floor over 5 seconds. Hamstring tendon conditioning essential for gymnastics.

name: Pigeon Stretch
description: Front shin across body, extend rear leg, hold. Deep hip external rotator and glute stretch. Protects the hip joint.

name: Single-Leg Balance Eyes Closed
description: Stand on one leg, close eyes, hold stable. Proprioception training for ankle and knee joint position sense.

name: Step-Down (slow eccentric)
description: Stand on step, lower opposite foot to tap floor over 5 seconds. Single-leg eccentric quad control for knee health.

name: Terminal Knee Extension (prehab)
description: Band behind knee, slight bend, extend against band. VMO activation drill for knee stability and patellar tracking.

name: Abdominal Bracing
description: Stand or lie, draw in navel then brace abs as if about to be punched. Hold 5 seconds. Teaches transverse abdominis activation.

name: Copenhagen Short Lever
description: Side plank with lower knee on bench (not foot), easier lever. Adductor and lateral core loading for groin protection.

name: Dead Bug (prehab)
description: Lie on back, arms and knees at 90°, lower opposite arm and leg with 5-second count. Maintain lower back flat throughout. Deep core stability.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
description: Lie on back, one hand on chest one on belly. Breathe so only belly hand rises. Diaphragm and deep core reset.

name: Hip Flexor Activation
description: Lie on back, press one hand against raised knee for 5 seconds, other leg straight. Psoas and hip flexor activation.

name: Hollow Body Progression
description: Progress from knees tucked to legs extended as strength allows. Build hollow body position incrementally without compensation.

name: McGill Big 3 — Bird Dog
description: From all fours, extend opposite arm/leg, hold 10 seconds, sweep under body. The complete McGill bird dog protocol.

name: McGill Big 3 — Curl-Up
description: Partial curl-up with hands under lumbar. Spine neutral throughout. One of McGill's essential spine stability exercises.

name: McGill Big 3 — Side Plank
description: Side plank held for progressively longer durations. Quadratus lumborum and lateral spine stabilizer activation.

name: Plank with Breathing
description: Hold plank and take 5 full breaths without losing position. Teaches maintaining brace under respiratory load.

name: Reverse Crunch (slow)
description: Curl hips to chest with 3-second lift and 3-second lower. Lower back stays in contact with floor throughout.

name: Segmental Roll-Down
description: Stand tall, tuck chin, roll down one vertebra at a time reaching hands toward floor. Spinal mobility and segmental control.

name: Stir the Pot (light)
description: Forearms on stability ball, make small circles. Begin with small range, build over time. Rotary stability under spinal load.

name: Suitcase Carry
description: Hold weight in one hand at side, walk maintaining upright posture. Anti-lateral flexion core stability under load.

name: Supine Leg Lowering
description: Both legs vertical, lower one slowly to just above floor. Back flat. Tests and builds lumbo-pelvic control.

name: Band External Rotation (90°)
description: Elbow at 90° at shoulder height, rotate forearm back against band resistance. Slow and controlled. Key rotator cuff activator before overhead work.

name: Band Internal Rotation
description: Elbow at 90° at side, rotate forearm inward against band. Balance to external rotation work. Essential for shoulder health.

name: Band Pull-Apart (prehab)
description: Hold band at chest width with straight arms, pull apart to full extension. Rear delt and external rotator activation.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
description: Pull one arm across chest with opposite hand, hold at point of tension. Posterior shoulder and rotator cuff mobility.

name: Cuban Press
description: From hang position, externally rotate to press overhead. Full shoulder health movement combining ER and press in one pattern.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
description: Stand in doorway, place forearms on frame, lean forward until stretch is felt in chest and front shoulder. Anterior shoulder mobility.

name: GIRD Stretch
description: Glenohumeral internal rotation deficit stretch — lie on side, shoulder at 90°, gently press wrist toward floor. Essential for throwing athletes.

name: Handstand Shoulder Shrug (prehab)
description: In wall handstand, perform small rhythmic shoulder shrugs (elevation and depression). Active shoulder end-range loading.

name: Overhead Banded Distraction
description: Band anchored low, place around wrist, raise arm overhead, allow band to gently distract the shoulder joint. Capsular mobility.

name: Prone T Raise (prehab)
description: Lie face down, raise arms to T (shoulder height) with thumbs up. Rear deltoid and mid trapezius activation.

name: Prone W Raise (prehab)
description: Lie face down, arms in W shape (elbows bent, hands up), raise off floor squeezing mid back. Lower trap focused.

name: Prone Y Raise (prehab)
description: Lie face down, raise arms to Y position with thumbs up. Light load only. Lower trapezius activation for shoulder stability.

name: Rotator Cuff ISOMETRIC
description: Press hand against wall at 90° elbow in each rotation direction. Hold 5 seconds each. Pain-free rotator cuff loading.

name: Scapular Push-up (prehab)
description: In push-up top position, alternate between protracting (pushing scapulae apart) and retracting. Serratus anterior activation.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
description: Back flat on wall, arms in W position, slide arms overhead into Y while maintaining wall contact. Trains scapular upward rotation pattern.

name: Shoulder CARs
description: Controlled articular rotations — trace the largest circle possible with your shoulder while maintaining tension. Go slow, feel the edge of your range.

name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Walk
description: Stand facing wall, walk fingers up wall as high as possible, hold briefly. Shoulder flexion range of motion.

name: Shoulder Pendulum
description: Lean forward, let arm hang freely, make small circles with gravity assisting. Joint decompression and gentle mobility warm-up.

name: Sleeper Stretch
description: Lie on side on affected shoulder, bend elbow 90°, use other hand to gently press wrist toward floor. Posterior capsule stretch.

name: Wall Angels
description: Stand with back flat on wall, arms overhead in Y, slowly bring elbows down to sides maintaining wall contact. Scapular control.
